gen-dafont-neon-gf-domine: Glowing bent-wire letters, Neon keeping a single line width throughout. Domine, a classic serif with a slight pinch where curves meet stems, brings the dignity that sets Neon's glow off.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-halant: A glowing hum of tall, stamped-metal letters with open spacing. Neon's bent-tube glow meets Halant, a text serif whose faint thick-thin shift and outward-pointing terminals keep it authoritative and traditional.
gen-dafont-neuropol-gf-bhutuka-expanded-: BhuTuka Expanded One reads slowly, curvy and unclamped, like a leisurely walk. Neuropol keeps its letters closed and outline-like, so the open, literary serif loosens the page around it.
gen-dafont-neuropol-gf-hepta-slab: Neuropol draws closed, outline-like letters with a slim channel, while Hepta Slab opens up with breathing counters and stretched words. Bookish and dignified, with bent-paperclip uniformity in every stroke.
gen-dafont-neuropol-gf-stint-ultra-expan: Futuristic and digital, Neuropol keeps its letters closed, tight, and outlined, with only a slim channel where the c opens. Stint Ultra Expanded, a classic serif, floats open letters against that tightness.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-lisu-bosa: Pulled-apart neon tubes with a compass-drawn steadiness, that is Neuropolitical. Lisu Bosa, a classic serif with sturdy hairlines beside moderate stems, lets paragraphs unspool feeling large, open, and editorial.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-serif-hentaig: Vintage and commanding, Woodgod stamps tall lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals, with a wide channel into every bowl. Noto Serif Hentaigana, a classic serif, adds refined, visible stroke modulation.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-ovo: Woodgod stamps vintage, commanding letters whose lowercase nearly meets the capitals. Ovo, a serif with thins only slightly lighter than its thicks, supplies the restraint that keeps the pair classic.
